sections.text:
WORK HISTORY
Macquarie Group Limited - Assistant Manager Gurgaon, India • 03/2025 - 12/2025
Worked extensively with the Order Management System (OMS),
supporting trade capture, order lifecycle management, and post- trade processing.
Partnered closely with the Front Office (Traders and Sales) to
resolve trade queries, validate trade bookings, and ensure timely execution of business processes.
Produced and validated daily Product Control P&L for Fixed Income and Credit products, ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting.
Collaborated with Front Office, Operations, Technology, and Risk teams to investigate trade breaks, system issues, and process improvements.
Gathered and documented business requirements for enhancements to order management and trade processing workflows, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
Supported UAT, validated system enhancements, and coordinated with stakeholders to ensure successful production deployment.
Supported Prime Brokerage Back-Office processes, including trade processing, reconciliation, exception investigation and resolution. • Worked on Prime Brokerage and Capital Markets processes, supporting end-to-end trade lifecycle and post-trade activities.
Capgemini Technology Service India Limited - Consultant Mumbai, India • 04/2022 - 03/2025
Worked as a Business Analyst in Capital Markets domain with exposure to Fixed Income, Equities, Listed & OTC Derivatives within a global banking environment.
Collaborated with Front Office, Middle Office, Risk, Operations, and IT stakeholders to gather and document business requirements for reference data, trade lifecycle, and financial reporting processes, ensuring alignment across teams. • Led automation initiatives to streamline static data setup, validation, and reconciliation processes, reducing manual intervention and improving SLA adherence.
Mapped AS-IS and TO-BE business processes to identify control gaps and inefficiencies, recommending automation opportunities across securities setup and master data workflows.
• Conducted requirement-gathering workshops and prepared BRD, FRD, functional specifications, and detailed user stories with clear acceptance criteria in an Agile environment.
Deutsche Bank Group - Analyst Mumbai, India • 08/2019 - 03/2022
Supported the Investment Banking business by performing
Product Control activities for Credit trading desks covering HY Bonds, IG Bonds, and CDS.
Partnered with Front Office Traders to validate daily P&L,
investigate valuation movements, and resolve trade-related queries.
Performed daily T+1 P&L production, validation, attribution, and reconciliation, ensuring accurate financial reporting.
Collaborated with Front Office, Risk, Finance, Operations, and Technology teams to resolve trade booking, valuation, and reconciliation issues.
Worked with Order Management Systems (OMS) to support trade capture, trade lifecycle, and accurate trade representation in downstream systems.
Performed valuation controls, cash break investigations, and balance sheet reconciliations to maintain a robust control framework.
Supported Product Control system enhancements, UAT, and process automation by collaborating with business and technology stakeholders.
Conducted root cause analysis of P&L exceptions and implemented process improvements to enhance controls and operational efficiency.
Cognizant Technology Solution India PVT LTD - Process Specialist Pune, India • 02/2018 - 08/2019
Reviewing, Performing & Reconciling P&L of Credit Products mainly - HY Bonds, CDS & IG with detailed analytical investigations and commentaries.
Perform daily Profit and Loss on T + 1 basis and investigate and explain flash to actual variances.
Reviewing the Daily P&L vs Risk-Based P&L decomposition to ensure accurate reporting of P&L. Justify material variance between Daily P&L & Risk Based P&L for the trading desk. • Monitored hedge relationships to manage Credit & Interest Rate Risk, escalating issues to Market Risk Committee.
Reviewed Daily P&L against Risk-Based P&L decomposition, ensuring accurate reporting and justifying material variances for trading desk.
Developing and maintaining control and supervisory framework to analyze, review and validate all adjustments to P&L. • Conducting root cause analysis, reducing the number of
exceptions through process training.
Reviewing the daily, Weekly & Monthly balance Sheet movements.
ACCOMPLISHMENTS
Awarded Quarterly “UNICORN” for Learning things quickly in short span of time and gaining the trust of Trading Desk.
Awarded as “Spotlight” for performance excellence. • Awarded as “UNICORN” for best performance • Awarded by Finance head for successfully migrating Valuation System
